items: SceneComposer: The SceneComposer is the top-level orchestrator for the Retiam animation engine. It owns all GPU resources (WebGPU device, Renderer, TextureManager, StateDataManager), manages the canvas and render loop, and composes multiple lightweight Scene instances into a single rendered output — similar to how After Effects manages Compositions.

The SceneComposer is the top-level orchestrator for the Retiam animation engine. It owns all GPU resources (WebGPU device, Renderer, TextureManager, StateDataManager), manages the canvas and render loop, and composes multiple lightweight Scene instances into a single rendered output — similar to how After Effects manages Compositions.
